claim: For S3 continuous backups, system tag-based event configuration supports all general purpose buckets in your account, matching your Amazon S3 bucket quota, while bucket-ARN-based event configuration supports up to 1,000 buckets per account.
question: How many S3 buckets per account can AWS Backup protect with each EventBridge event configuration method?

values.spoken: up to one thousand buckets per account

values.display: all general purpose buckets in your account

qualifiers.scope: per account, S3 buckets protected with the bucket-ARN method
qualifiers.condition: bucket-ARN method is used when the backup role lacks s3:ListTagsForResource

evidence.quote: **System tag-based event configuration (recommended)**: AWS Backup tags your bucket with the `aws:backup:enabled` system tag and creates a single managed Amazon EventBridge rule (named `AwsBackupManagedRule-BucketSystemTag`) that filters on this tag. S3 includes the tag in every event notification sent to Amazon EventBridge. This method supports all general purpose buckets in your account, matching your Amazon S3 bucket quota.

**Bucket-ARN-based event configuration**: If the backup role does not have `s3:ListTagsForResource` permission, AWS Backup creates managed Amazon EventBridge rules (named `AwsBackupManagedRule-{{N}}`) that list individual bucket ARNs. This method supports up to 1,000 buckets per account.
